scope_caveat: Local optimum over the explicitly tested candidate pool only; not a mathematical or global proof of optimality.

authority.note: PASS covers only the 8 complete configurations in the pool: raw baseline, registry canonical export, preferred six, five-swap keeping Swan Song, six-swap cutting Ashad and keeping Blasphemous Act, Pass C pairings six-swap (Fiery over Weeping Angel, Disintegration over This Is How It Ends), the Artillerist-over-Sycorax seven-swap and the Flame Rift-over-Ashad seven-swap. It also covers the named single-card contenders. They were judged with finite current-Oracle rules cases; bounded enumerations answering the Pass C requested measured tests (a 16-case Unlicensed Disintegration grid; Ingenious Artillerist vs Purphoros over 5 entry patterns, removal response and a second Davros resolution; Fiery Confluence vs Boltwave and Maestros Charm, including the 608.2b artifact-target failure); Commander Spellbook combo lookups (0 included combos in both lists); and a quantity-counted mana comparison. Tests run locally and in .github/workflows/m7-davros-dalek-creator.yml; run URLs are recorded in the PR body. There is no statistical multiplayer ranking, no matched opponent/mana sample and no removal-response rate. The A/B seals and the owner-equivalent Pass C (final disposition NEEDS TESTING) are historical, baseline-scoped and not technically independent. Nothing here implies owner approval, M6 certification, M7 approval or a canonical change.
